interpretation: Matched CONTROL and ATTACK traces are exactly equal before onset, so the pre-onset matched-distance p95 is zero. The M4-R2 definition therefore required post-attack trajectories to become exactly identical for three consecutive windows. Failure to do so does not establish persistent malicious activity or label corruption; deterministic trajectories can remain counterfactually different after a perturbation.
